about: What `fast-test` runs for a change (see ~/Code/fast-test). Everything here runs on The Dragon in the dev shell. The NixOS checks (product, VM, boot, ISO) stay on the manual nixos.yml workflow on The Beast's runner: run it by hand when someone asks.

steps.name: regression
steps.about: The source and fixture regression suite.

steps.name: shell
steps.about: QML lint and the shell's runtime tests, when the Quickshell config changed. Alone: its real-engine checks are left out while another test's Quickshell is alive, and the regression step starts some.

steps.name: single-tests
steps.about: A changed standalone test script. Alone and one after the other: several of them wait, or leave their real-engine checks out, while another test's Quickshell is alive.
steps.run: nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' develop --command sh -c 'for f in "$@"; do python3 -B "$f" || exit 1; done' sh {files}

steps.name: web
steps.about: The website: lint, types and tests.
steps.run: cd web && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; } && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
